rules.title: Net energy requirement at NPCL's bus: less what is delivered there

clause.regulation: UPERC MYT Regulations 2025 — energy balance, as the order of 2 July 2026 lays it out (Table 6-9): the requirement at NPCL's bus less what is delivered there, grossed up for the intra-state loss, less what is connected at the STU bus, grossed up for the inter-state loss

rules.note: draft: the order's layout as it prints it (two of its printed formula labels are slips: 'C=A*(1-1/(1-B))' gives a negative loss, 'D=A+B' is A + C; its figures follow the arithmetic)
